facts.note: At nine, the temple bell; watches shown. Hers exact, the doctor's two minutes ahead, Girard would not take his out.

Hall clock struck ten when the regulator showed 12 to ten; master said what he always says about it; at the temple's ten the regulator agreed with the bell exactly. Worked beside the master in the atelier after dinner.
Sent down when the regulator showed 10:20; regulator running and he was well; went straight to the kitchen.
That afternoon, master seen in the kitchen with Rosa's clock in his hands, laughing; she did not ask why.
Rosa's clock read 10:58 when Madame's piano began and 11:11 when it stopped.
Stayed in the kitchen with Rosa until after the temple struck eleven.
